g.text: An interconnected first zone: inhabited streets, a ceremonial heart, and useful height. Design proposal; not a finished level.
Roof ridge and spire are scenery.
Every height route has two entrances.
A failed jump lands on a lower route.
R1 / R2 ritual / boss space reserved
L1 / L2 crypt stairs; no one-way pit
Break roof sightlines with roof volumes.
Upper routes overlook parts of a court.
No roof sees every spawn or objective.
Keep the two ground returns useful.
Use slate and masonry for the screens.
No Studio or game code changed.
